style.backgroundSystem: one continuous seamless sweep: base white #FFFFFF for packshots and macro, warm off-white #F5F2EC for group and lifestyle, cool light grey #ECEFF2 board for lineup and grid screens; never gradient, never tinted
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons plus plain check and dash marks in amber #E0912F on cool light grey #ECEFF2 hairline rails
style.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under every item, small controlled speculars on metal ends, no dramatic shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian 3C-accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless base white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F5F2EC, cool light grey #ECEFF2 and one amber accent #E0912F; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, bounce fill and soft contact shadows only, small controlled speculars on metal ends; modern geometric sans-serif; hairline rails and thin single-weight icons in the same amber accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic components; stable upright product angle, even spacing and consistent scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or badges
style.presentationRules: upright items keep one identical angle and consistent scale across the whole set; group and lineup shots keep even spacing on a shared baseline; the label face always turns to camera
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep in base white #FFFFFF or warm off-white #F5F2EC, cool light grey #ECEFF2 board when a grid or lineup needs separation from the backdrop
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; in-image copy reduced to empty headline bands and bracketed label slots, all marketing wording carried by placeholders
